notice.back: Button on the page-not-found and error pages: back to the home page.
hub.tabs.home: Home page section: the overview with Drive and the current picks.
hub.tabs.laps: Home page section: online lap time boards.
hub.tabs.download: Home page section: desktop and Android apps.
hub.unread: Screen-reader text after What's new while it has notes the visitor hasn't opened.
hub.sections: Screen-reader name of the row of home page sections.
hub.skip: Link for keyboard users that skips the header to the page content.
hub.heading: The home page's main heading, read by screen readers and search engines.
hub.drive: The home page's main button: start the game on the chosen circuit and car.
hub.prompts.move: Button prompt at the bottom of the screen: the stick or D-pad moves the cursor.
hub.prompts.select: Button prompt: press the highlighted item.
hub.prompts.switchSection: Button prompt: shoulder buttons or Q / E switch home page sections.
hub.prompts.page: Button prompt: triggers turn the lap times board's pages.
hub.prompts.drive: Button prompt: Start or Enter starts the game.
hub.length: A circuit's length and corners. {distance}: number such as 4.32; {unit}: km or mi, not translated; {turns}: number of corners. The space before {unit} is a no-break space.
hub.classYear: Under a car's name. {class}: car class; {year}: model year.
hub.footer: Current picks in the footer. {venue}: circuit; {car}: car. Names are not translated.
hub.driveTile.label: Screen-reader name of the big Drive tile. {venue}, {layout}: circuit and layout; {car}: car. Names are not translated.
hub.driveTile.title: Big word on the main tile that starts the game.
hub.driveTile.detail: Line under it: what you'll drive. Names are not translated.
hub.circuitTile.label: Screen-reader name of the tile that opens the circuit list. {venue}, {layout}: the current circuit.
hub.circuitTile.more: Link text at the bottom of the circuit tile.
hub.circuitTile.map: Screen-reader name of the circuit map with a dot lapping it.
hub.circuitTile.onLine: After the live speed under the map (such as 212 km/h): the speed of the ideal racing line at the dot.
hub.carTile.label: Screen-reader name of the tile that opens the car list. {car}: car name.
hub.carTile.more: Link text at the bottom of the car tile.
hub.press.title: Articles and videos about the game, and the press kit.
hub.press.label: Screen-reader name of the press tile. {count} picks the plural form; {n}: the same number.
hub.press.count: {count} picks the plural form; {n}: the same number.
hub.press.onPlatform: Link to one article or video. {outlet}: who published it; {platform}: where (YouTube, Instagram). Not translated.
hub.whatsNew.commits: Code changes on that day, linking to them on GitHub. A commit is one saved change to the code.
hub.filterOption: One option of a filter list with how many items it leaves. {option}: the option, not translated.
hub.venueFilters.type.label: Circuit filter: the kind of course (permanent circuit, street, hill climb).
hub.venueFilters.country.label: Circuit filter: the country it is in.
hub.venueFilters.modder.label: Circuit filter: who made the circuit's 3D model (a modder is someone who makes game add-ons).
hub.carFilters.class.label: Car filter: the car class.
hub.carFilters.physics.label: Car filter: whether the car has its own physics model.
hub.carFilters.physics.all: First option of the Physics filter: no filtering.
hub.carFilters.modder.label: Car filter: who made the car's 3D model.
hub.circuits.shown: {shown} of {total}: numbers of circuits after filtering.
hub.circuits.personalBest: Screen-reader name of the stopwatch icon before your best lap on a circuit.
hub.circuits.oldPhysics: Your best lap here was driven on an older physics version.
hub.circuits.carOldPhysics: Your best lap here was in another car ({car}, not translated) on an older physics version. Old = old physics; keep it short.
hub.cars.shown: {shown} of {total}: numbers of cars after filtering.
hub.about.addModText: {email}: the developer's email address. Keep the <mail></mail> tags around it; they make it a link.
hub.about.moddersText: About the people who made the circuits' and cars' 3D models.
hub.about.contributors: Heading over the people who sent in code (pull requests) that is now in the game. Not the modders: they made the 3D models.
hub.about.contributorsText: One line under that heading, thanking the people listed.
hub.about.links.support: Link to the developer's tip page (Buy Me a Coffee). Translate the meaning ('support the developer') if the phrase doesn't work in your language.
hub.facts.platforms.label: Label: what devices the game runs on.
hub.facts.price.text: Tips are optional payments to the developer; they unlock nothing in the game.
lapTimes.unreachable: The online lap times server didn't answer; the page keeps trying.
boards.board: Screen-reader name of the switch between the three boards.
boards.allLaps: Board of every lap on a circuit.
boards.lapTimesTitle: Heading of the board of every lap.
boards.week: Screen-reader name of the list of challenge weeks.
boards.thisWeek: The current challenge week in the week list. {circuit}: circuit name.
boards.pastWeek: A past challenge week. {dates}: such as 9–15 Nov; {circuit}: circuit name.
boards.timeLeft: {timeLeft}: time until the week ends, such as 3 d 4 h, already formatted.
boards.ran: A past week's dates. {dates}: such as 9–15 Nov.
boards.rules: Screen-reader name of the challenge's rules (realism and assists badges).
layoutPicker.chosen: Screen-reader name of a circuit's layout picker. {venue}: circuit; {layout}: layout name, not translated; {index} of {count}: its position in the list.
layoutPicker.closed: Screen-reader name of the picker on a circuit that isn't chosen. {count}: how many layouts it has.
layoutPicker.count: How many layouts (track variants) a circuit has.
liveryPicker.custom: The player's own colour scheme, as opposed to the preset liveries.
liveryPicker.chosen: Screen-reader name of a car's livery picker. {car}: car; {livery}: livery name, not translated; {index} of {count}: its position.
liveryPicker.chosenCustom: The same while the custom paint is on. {count}: how many preset liveries there are.
liveryPicker.closed: Screen-reader name of the picker on a car that isn't chosen. {count}: how many liveries it has.
liveryPicker.count: How many liveries (paint schemes) a car has.
downloads.intro: The apps are thin wrappers around the website (librecorsa.org, not translated).
downloads.thisDevice: Badge on the platform the visitor is using now.
downloads.installed: Badge: the Android app is already installed (shown inside it).
downloads.artifact: Screen-reader name of a download button. {label}: the button's text; {platform}: Windows, macOS…; {detail}: file type and architecture.
downloads.artifactSized: The same with the file size. {size}: such as 92 MB.
downloads.detailSized: {detail}: file type and architecture; {size}: such as 92 MB.
downloads.detailPending: A file that will appear with the next release.
downloads.installCommand: Screen-reader name of a box with a terminal command. {platform}: operating system name.
downloads.highlights.desktop.text: Technical terms (GPU, WebHID, DualSense, GitHub Releases) usually stay as they are.
downloads.highlights.android.text: Trusted Web Activity, Android Game Mode: Android feature names, usually kept as they are. Drive / Boards are the app's shortcut names.
downloads.highlights.browser.text: Share and Add to Home Screen are Safari's menu items: use the names Apple uses in your language.
downloads.builds: Keep the tags around {file}; it is a file path, not translated. SignPath Foundation, GitHub Actions and GitHub Releases are names.
downloads.signingPolicy: Link to the page that explains how the Windows apps are code-signed.
hub.prompts.back: Button prompt: back to the Home section.
hub.tabs.about: Home page section: what the game is, the modders and the press.
hub.about.links.docs: Link to the game's documentation site.
downloads.platforms: Heading of the list of operating systems the apps are made for.
hub.facts.physics.label: Label in the list of game facts: the physics simulation.
hub.facts.racing.label: Label in the list of game facts: the kinds of racing.
hub.facts.controls.label: Label in the list of game facts: what it can be played with.
hub.facts.conditions.label: Label in the list of game facts: weather and time of day.
hub.facts.price.label: Label in the list of game facts: what it costs.
